description: This Lua source file provides a module for tracking garbage collection of tables by setting custom finalizers via metatables. It enables starting and stopping the tracking process, marking collected tables with a progress indicator.

classes.name: mt
classes.description: Metatable with a custom __gc method to track when a table is garbage collected.

methods.name: mt.__gc
methods.description: Custom garbage collector finalizer that marks progress and, if active, reassigns the metatable for further finalization.

methods.name: M.start
methods.description: Starts the garbage collection tracking by enabling the active flag and creating an initial tracked table.

methods.name: M.stop
methods.description: Stops the tracking, disables the active flag, and runs garbage collection to finalize any remaining objects.
